subject.title: [Feature]: Add Qwen 3.6 Flash and current Gemini Live model

question: Should OpenClaw update both bundled provider surfaces now, including making `gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview` the default for unconfigured Google realtime voice sessions?
rationale: The Qwen catalog addition is straightforward provider metadata, but the Google change is a default model choice on a preview realtime surface and the issue has a protected maintainer label.

options.title: Approve focused provider update
options.body: Add `qwen3.6-flash`, switch the Google Live default, update docs/tests, and require live or official-provider proof before merge.

options.title: Split Qwen from Google policy
options.body: Add Qwen Flash now, but keep the Google Live default unchanged until the broader preview-default policy is explicitly settled.

options.title: Keep as policy discussion
options.body: Leave implementation paused and use this issue to decide provider default criteria before any catalog or default changes land.

recommendation.title: Approve focused provider update
recommendation.body: Add `qwen3.6-flash`, switch the Google Live default, update docs/tests, and require live or official-provider proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to `steipete`, and provider/default history points to the same person as the most relevant decision owner.
